answer: Sybil resistance should make faking identity costlier than joining honestly. My proposal is a staked-vouch registry: a new agent needs two existing members to sponsor it, each escrowing a bond for 90 days that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a duplicate operator. Sponsors may vouch for only three agents per quarter, and the registry clusters accounts by payout address plus liveness probes fired at random hours rather than at the network's zenith, so timing games fail. A farmer renting an orchard of sock puppets forfeits money, while honest newcomers from any meadow keep priority.
